description_sq:
Shesim Apartament 3+1+2 tek Kodra e Diellit.
Apartamenti disponon nje siperfaqe totale prej 153m2 dhe ndodhet ne katin e 5 te nje godine 6 kateshe ne rrugen Bill Klinton.
Organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje bashke me kendin e gatimit dhe te ngrenies, 3 dhoma gjumi, verand, 2 tualete dhe nje ballkon.
Orientimi Jug-Veri i jep mundesine qe te kete drite natyrale gjate pjeses me te madhe te dites.
Per nje vizite ne prone jeni te mirepritur te na kontaktoni!
title_en: Apartment 3+1+2 in the Hill of the Sun!!
description_en: We are selling Apartment 3+1+2 at Kodra e Diellit. The apartment has a total area of ​​153m2 and is located on the 5th floor of a 6-story building on Bill Clinton Street. It is organized in a living room with a cooking and dining area, 3 bedrooms, veranda, 2 toilets and a balcony. The South-North orientation gives it the opportunity to have natural light during most of the day. For a visit to the property, you are welcome to contact us!
